description: Defines structures, a class, and methods for managing Virtual BSS (VBSS) actions, including creation, destruction, capability requests, move requests, security context requests, and channel switch announcements within the vbss namespace.

classes.name: vbss::sClientVBSS
classes.description: Represents a client VBSS with VBSSID, client MAC, association status, and current connected RUID.

classes.name: vbss::sClientSecCtxInfo
classes.description: Holds security context information for a client, including connection status, key lengths, security keys, and packet numbers.

classes.name: vbss::vbss_actions
classes.description: Provides static methods to perform VBSS-related actions such as create, destroy, request capabilities, move requests, security context requests, and channel switch announcements.

methods.name: create_vbss
methods.description: Sends a request to create a virtual VBSS for a client with specified SSID and password, using security context if available.

methods.name: destroy_vbss
methods.description: Sends a request to destroy a specified VBSS, optionally disassociating the client.

methods.name: request_ap_radio_vbss_caps
methods.description: Requests the capabilities of an AP radio via a virtual BSS capabilities request.

methods.name: send_move_prep_request
methods.description: Sends a move preparation request for a client VBSS.

methods.name: send_move_cancel_request
methods.description: Sends a move cancel request for a client VBSS.

methods.name: send_client_security_ctx_request
methods.description: Requests the client security context from an agent.

methods.name: send_trigger_channel_switch_announcement
methods.description: Sends a trigger channel switch announcement to an agent for a client VBSS.

methods.name: send_client_info_tlv_msg
methods.description: Private method to send a message with client info TLV of a specific message type.
